Left alone deliberately; when the warning value is decided this entry goes to 0.

design-system/src/components/layout-and-.why: An 8% black mix over the primary state layer on the open header's hover. Outside the 2026-10-24 audit's scope (the patterns, the Popover family, Button, Field and the controls). The fix Button and Dropdown took applies: lay --color-shadow-state-NN over the fill, which composites to the color the mix produced; compare the pixels before lowering this.
